elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: The prohibition applies only to a “defaulting Party” and only “in respect of such default,” rather than barring all liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer. The clause also retains formula-based extended payment charges.

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: The clause does not limit Customer-payable liquidated amounts to an early-termination fee and retains formula-based extended payment charges for late payment.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: The rendered language neither identifies an early-termination fee as the sole liquidated amount nor broadly excludes other Customer-payable liquidated amounts.
